preparation.description: Immutable record-aligned uncompressed FASTQ; each 1M prefix verified against earlier checksum-verified calibration cache.
preparation.limits: first8M for six configured sweep samples; first1M or EOF for remaining samples
preparation.remote_integrity_note: Staged full/prefix SHA-256 verifies comparison identity. Partial remote downloads do not verify full upstream compressed MD5.

limitations: Local uncompressed fixed-prefix calibration, not held-out truth; network/gzip/BLAST excluded.
Whole unchanged panels are timed; recovery is assessed by target metadata and per-product evidence, not raw total products.
Small number of paired measurements supports descriptive comparisons, not portable statistical guarantees.
40 GiB virtual-address limit is not an RSS cap or 16 GB laptop validation.
protocol.priority: 2026-09-11 user: protect abundant organelle/ribosomal recovery and runtime/RAM; metagenomic and single-copy nuclear optimization deferred
protocol.purpose: High-copy-focused final comparison: unchanged non-metagenomic panels, released v3.1.0 vs combined154155

review_criteria.deferred: Metagenomic and single-copy nuclear diversity/recovery are not current release gates.
review_criteria.failures: Any nonzero CLI exit, timeout, resource breach, count mismatch, invalid provenance/output or BLAST evaluation error invalidates that cell.
review_criteria.ram: Report every increase; prioritize investigation of >2% per-cell paired median RSS increase.
review_criteria.recovery: Flag every lost high-copy candidate; prioritize reference-supported and dominant products. Compare sequence membership independent of index, retain classification and median/minimum support. Do not require restoration of unsupported repeat-copy claims.
review_criteria.release: Stop before release for user review, regardless of numeric thresholds.
review_criteria.runtime: Report every increase; prioritize investigation of >5% per-cell paired median wall increase. Descriptive only; no automatic no-regression claim.
